## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin in meinem Element.** — [ikh bin in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm in my element.*
2. **Das lässt mich nicht los.** — [das lesst mikh nikht LOHS] — *I can't stop thinking about it. / It won't let me go.*
3. **Mir fällt ein Stein vom Herzen.** — [meer felt ayn shtayn fom HAIR-tsen] — *That's a weight off my mind.*
